001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an activity categorized as taking place at school, such as a
007 * lecture or lab. Common fields and behavior are inherited from
008 * {@link Activity}.
009 * </p>
010 * <p>
011 * Example:
012 * </p>
013 * <code>new SchoolActivity("CIS 2430 Lecture", start, end)</code>
014 */
015public class SchoolActivity extends Activity {
016    /*
017     * Constructors
018     */
019
020    /**
021     * Constructs a <code>SchoolActivity</code> with a title, start time, and end
022     * time.
023     * 
024     * @param title     The activity title.
025     * @param startTime The start time.
026     * @param endTime   The end time.
027     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
028     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
029     *                                  strictly before endTime.
030     */
031    public SchoolActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime)
032    throws IllegalArgumentException {
033        super(title, startTime, endTime);
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * Constructs a <code>SchoolActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
038     * and comment.
039     * 
040     * @param title     The activity title.
041     * @param startTime The start time.
042     * @param endTime   The end time.
043     * @param comment   Optional note; null or blank values are treated as no
044     *                  comment.
045     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title is null or blank, if startTime or
046     *                                  endTime is null, or if startTime is not
047     *                                  strictly before endTime.
048     */
049    public SchoolActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
050    throws IllegalArgumentException {
051        super(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * Constructs a <code>SchoolActivity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity
056     * Serial) string.
057     * 
058     * @param ras Serialized activity entry, normally produced by {@link #toRAS()}.
059     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
060     */
061    public SchoolActivity(String ras)
062    throws RasException {
063        super(ras);
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * <p>
068     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>SchoolActivity</code> that is a
069     * duplicate of the given <code>SchoolActivity</code>, preventing co-references
070     * that could cause privacy leaks.
071     * </p>
072     *
073     * @param other The <code>SchoolActivity</code> to copy.
074     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
075     */
076    public SchoolActivity(SchoolActivity other)
077    throws IllegalArgumentException {
078        super(other);
079    }
080
081    /**
082     * Creates and returns a copy of this {@code SchoolActivity}.
083     * 
084     * @return A duplicate copy of this SchoolActivity.
085     */
086    @Override
087    public Activity copy() {
088        return new SchoolActivity(this);
089    }
090
091
092
093    /*
094     * Activity Overrides
095     */
096
097
098    
099    /**
100     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
101     * Activity.
102     * 
103     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For SchoolActivities, this is
104     *         <code>SCHOOL</code>.
105     */
106    @Override
107    public ActivityType getType() {
108        return ActivityType.SCHOOL;
109    }
110
111    
112
113    /*
114     * Object Overrides
115     */
116
117    /**
118     * Determines whether this school activity is equal to another object.
119     * 
120     * @param other The object to compare with.
121     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
122     *         otherwise.
123     */
124    @Override
125    public boolean equals(Object other) {
126        if (this == other)
127            return true;
128        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
129            return false;
130        return super.equals(other);
131    }
132}
